walkthrough.aiSocialScientist.gettingSta: Set up project initialization, LLM configuration, backend startup, and skill installation to start using AI Social Scientist for research.
walkthrough.step.welcome.title: Welcome to AI Social Scientist
walkthrough.step.welcome.description: Learn about the plugin's research workflow, system components, and quickest getting-started path.
walkthrough.step.openSidebar.title: Meet the Sidebar
walkthrough.step.openSidebar.description: Open the AI Social Scientist sidebar — your main entry point for managing projects, skills, and configuration.
walkthrough.step.initProject.title: Initialize a Research Project
walkthrough.step.initProject.description: Create a project directory structure, or open an existing research workspace.
walkthrough.step.configureApi.title: Configure LLM API
walkthrough.step.configureApi.descriptio: Enter your API Key and API Base URL to connect the plugin to a large language model service.
walkthrough.step.startBackend.title: Start the Backend Service
walkthrough.step.startBackend.descriptio: Start the local API service for the full plugin experience: agent skill management, module detection, prefill parameters, replay interface, and API docs all depend on it. Config editing and CLI/Claude Code experiment runs are not blocked by backend status.
walkthrough.step.exploreSkills.title: Explore the Skill Marketplace
walkthrough.step.exploreSkills.descripti: Browse and install research skill modules to add capabilities like literature search and experiment design to your agents.
walkthrough.step.claudeCode.title: Connect Claude Code
walkthrough.step.claudeCode.description: Let Claude Code read project skills and connect to the local backend via MCP as the default coding and research collaboration entry point.
walkthrough.step.nextSteps.title: Next Steps
walkthrough.step.nextSteps.description: Discover more features including simulation replay, chat conversations, and other advanced usage.
walkthrough.step.glossary.title: Glossary
walkthrough.step.glossary.description: Quick reference for key concepts like AgentSociety², Agent, Skill, MCP, and more.
